summary: Around August 11, 2026 the Douglas County Sheriff's Office in Kansas noticed suspicious activity on some of its computer systems and disconnected them as a precaution. Its website features, including the jail booking log, online inmate reports and fingerprint scheduling, were offline for days, and Lawrence police temporarily lost access to the shared Spillman CAD system and reports; 911 and dispatch were not interrupted. The office acknowledged the issue on August 14, would not confirm or deny ransomware or say whether personal data was exposed, and the county withheld records citing public safety. Sources reported a same-day cyberattack on the City of Eudora may be related, which officials would not confirm.
